data.narrative:
Chai Discovery is a Series C biotech company currently valued at $3.8B post-money, having raised $400M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a comp universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage companies in Biotech & Health, including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B Series C), New Limit ($3.1B Series C), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M Series B).

Two valuation methods are applicable. The peer-median approach yields $3.1B, grounded in the median valuation of same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables ranging from $539M to $10.3B. The stage-progression method, applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C to Series D advancement, implies $6.5B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied as Chai Discovery's revenue is not disclosed, which is standard for private-stage companies; the sector's median P/S multiple is 8.1x across three public tickers but lacks target-specific revenue to calibrate.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $2.6B (floor) to $7.4B (ceiling), with a median of $4.8B. The wide range reflects material uncertainty around stage-appropriate risk adjustments and the substantial dispersion within the peer set ($539M–$10.3B). Key sensitivities include the company's clinical/technical advancement velocity, capital efficiency relative to peers, and the timing and stage of the next financing event.
